description: David's experiments with his condition grow more dangerous as he encounters a radioactive meteor, another gamma-powered man and people who discover pieces of his secret, making the possibility of a cure feel both closer and more perilous.

s04e01.description: A radioactive meteor interrupts David's transformation and leaves him trapped between man and Hulk as a secret military project closes in.

s04e02.description: Government scientists capture the half-transformed David as a supposed extraterrestrial while McGee tries to convince them the Hulk is human.

s04e03.description: David works with a skydiving team whose returning star becomes embroiled in a dangerous feud with a local politician's family.

s04e04.description: David's attempt to suppress the Hulk chemically releases a darker, violent personality that threatens the family sheltering him.

s04e05.description: An electrical accident gives David flashes of the immediate future while a power-plant crisis and a sick coworker demand his attention.

s04e06.description: A professional mercenary constructs an elaborate trap specifically to locate and kill the Hulk, using David's predictable compassion against him.

s04e07.description: David drives a car across the country without knowing mob money is hidden inside, attracting two competing groups determined to recover it.

s04e08.description: A hard-boiled private investigator initially suspects David in a blackmail case, then recruits him to uncover the real culprit.

s04e09.description: David encourages a gentle weightlifter to enter a bodybuilding contest, where a small-time hustler sees an opportunity to exploit him.

s04e10.description: David takes work in a wax museum and tries to help its owner distinguish terrifying hallucinations from a very real threat connected to her father's death.

s04e11.description: A mysterious bride and hidden treasure in David's Chinatown apartment pull him into a conflict between gangsters, his landlady and an aging policeman.

s04e12.description: David follows reports of another Hulk to an old laboratory and meets the man who claims he once suffered the same gamma mutation.

s04e13.description: The first Hulk is unleashed again while David races to synthesize an antidote that might cure both men before the rival creature kills again.

s04e14.description: A car accident leaves David paralyzed, and he gambles on the Hulk's regenerative power as his only chance to walk again.

s04e15.description: A respected reporter discovers David's identity and persuades him to tell the Hulk's story, while McGee follows the same trail.

s04e16.description: David befriends flamboyant wrestler Buster Caldwell, whose boastful schemes put both men in trouble with people considerably more dangerous than a wrestling crowd.

s04e17.description: David tries to help a young widow and her baby escape a criminal brother-in-law who refuses to let them leave.

s04e18.description: A clothing manufacturer stakes everything on a fashion show while violent loan sharks come to collect, drawing employee David into the crisis.
